name: Quaggoth
traits: Medium Monstrous Humanoid. +8 Strength, +4 Constitution, −4 Intelligence, +2 Wisdom, derived from the original stat block using the core monster ability-score rule.
Land speed 30 ft. Darkvision 60 ft. and +4 natural armor.
Climb speed 30 ft. gives +8 on Climb checks and lets the quaggoth take 10 even under pressure.
Immune to fear. Scent normally detects creatures within 30 ft. Spend a move action for direction, and pinpoint the source within 5 ft.
Two primary claws each deal 1d4 piercing and slashing damage. The secondary bite deals 1d4 bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. Apply Strength modifiers to these base dice.

Rage (Ex). After taking damage in combat, check the following round for a 50% chance to rage. Magic-followers instead rage on 1 in 6 and drop their weapons. Rage grants +4 Strength and imposes −4 AC. The quaggoth fights with claws and bite until it or its opponent dies and cannot end the rage voluntarily.

Magic-followers paint or dye their fur and gain a +2 circumstance bonus on Hide checks in shadowy areas. Beast-followers leave their fur white and fight with natural weapons. The original entry describes classed quaggoths as never gaining spellcasting.
Three racial Hit Dice (3d8) grant BAB +3, base Fortitude +1, Reflex +3, Will +3, and two feats. The updated racial skill list has Climb, Hide, Listen, Spot, and Survival.
Quaggoths speak a dialect of Undercommon. LA +2, so ECL 5 before class levels. Favored class Barbarian.
Uses the Monsters of Faerûn entry carried forward by Underdark and revised by the 2004 Monster Update. The 2007 Drow of the Underdark uses a separate four-racial-Hit-Die profile.
